       d)       Consideration of Bid #E-21-24 for or one (1) new 2024 to 2026 Low Ground
                Pressure/Waste handling Dozer (42,000 lb mm. operating weight) for the Landfill
                Division. (Solid Waste Fund)

Mr. Cook moved to accept the bid from Wyoming Machinery Company in an amount not to exceed
5593,506.00, seconded by Mr. Johnson. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Sam Quattrini, Landfill Manager, provided a staff report.

       e)       Consideration of Bid #E-22-24 for one (I) new 2024 to 2026 Low Ground
                                handling Dozer (50.000 lb mm. operating weight) for the Landfill
                Division. (Solid Waste Fund)

Mr. Cook moved to accept the bid from Wyoming Machinery Company in an amount not to exceed
5820,267.00.00, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Sam Quattrini, Landfill Manager, provided a staff report and Bryan Bell, Fleet Manager, provided
additional information. Committee member Johnson commented on the item,
